 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. WEST LAFAYETTE — It's the home opener for Purdue men's basketball as the Boilermakers play host to an upstart Missouri Valley Conference school in Valparaiso .
 It's a bounce-back spot for the No. 24 Boilers, who opened with a 78-72 loss to No. 12 Gonzaga on Monday in Las Vegas. One positive, among several, was the development 7-foot-4 center Daniel Jacobsen showed. He had 22 points and seven rebounds, and the Boilers were certainly better when he was on the floor.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Meanwhile, the Beacons were picked fifth in the MVC preseason poll in coach Roger Powell Jr.'s fourth season, its highest in at least a decade after being picked 10th or worst the previous three seasons. Powell was 121-13 as an assistant coach at Gonzaga before returning to Valpo as the leader of its program. Valpo won its season opener 80-58 against Western Illinois with JT Pettigrew scoring 18 points, his ninth straight game with at least 10.
 One key to the game is going to be rebounding. Purdue handled Fort Wayne and Ball State in its exhibitions, and only lost the rebounding margin by three to the Zags. Meanwhile Valparaiso was plus-8 in its opener and plus-3 on the offensive glass.
 Follow along for live stats, analysis, postgame reaction and more (continues below gallery).
